research.title: Evaluating Semantic Segmentation Robustness under Image Corruptions
bullets: Designed experiments with supervisor guidance to evaluate semantic segmentation under blur, noise, and illumination shifts, controlling data splits and augmentation settings.
Implemented corruption pipelines and compared classwise intersection over union across conditions, inspecting prediction overlays to characterize boundary errors and small object failures.

projects.title: Comparative Evaluation of Image Classification Transfer Learning
bullets: Implemented frozen feature extraction and end to end fine tuning for pretrained convolutional classifiers using consistent preprocessing and training partitions.
Compared classification accuracy and confusion patterns across training strategies, examining how augmentation choices affected predictions for visually similar categories.

projects.title: Local Feature Matching for Planar Image Alignment
bullets: Implemented image alignment pipelines using Harris corners and patch descriptors, comparing raw intensity descriptors against normalized patches under controlled transformations.
Estimated homographies with robust sampling and evaluated reprojection errors, inspecting failed matches in repetitive textures and images with limited overlap.

projects.title: Classical and Neural Approaches to Image Denoising
bullets: Implemented Gaussian filtering, median filtering, and a convolutional denoising autoencoder, using matched image partitions and synthetic noise generation for comparison.
Compared reconstruction quality using peak signal to noise ratio and structural similarity, inspecting edge preservation and residual artifacts across noise conditions.
